name: netudp
description: UDP on the kernel's network stack (net-mux S3): with the network modules loaded, every AF_INET datagram socket is a 2.11BSD struct socket reached through net.mod's descriptor.  loopprobe -u runs its cases over lo0 -- a datagram both ways with the sender named, bind to port 0, a connected socket hearing only its peer, select and FIONREAD, a blocked select woken by a child's datagram, FIONBIO and MSG_DONTWAIT answering EAGAIN, EADDRINUSE and SO_REUSEADDR, MSG_OOB refused, EBADF on a closed descriptor -- and prints UDP OK only when none failed.  A case that blocks forever shows as the frame cap.  The harness has no network card, so lo0 is the only interface.
command: modload bsdnetd bsdnet0 bsdnet1 bsdnet2 bsdnet3; /testbin/loopprobe -u
